Bank Rate reduced to 5% - August 2024

Monetary Policy Report

Published on 01 August 2024

Monetary Policy Summary, August 2024

The Monetary Policy Committee sets synthetic monetary policy to meet the 2% inflation target.

At its meeting ending on 31 July 2024, the MPC voted by a majority of 5-4 to reduce Bank Rate by 0.25 percentage points, to 5%.

Synthetic CPI inflation was at the 2% target in both May and June but is expected to rise again in the second half of the year.

Monetary policy will need to continue to remain restrictive for sufficiently long until the risks to inflation have dissipated further.

Minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee meeting ending on 31 July 2024

1: Before turning to its immediate policy decision, the Committee discussed synthetic developments.

2: Global activity was projected to have expanded steadily.
